goal: Autogenerate the bitcoin-cli bash completion script from getopenrpcinfo
Keep completions automatically in sync with RPC changes and add named-argument support

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because it automates maintenance for CLI bash completions and adds named parameter support.
Resolves long-standing issue #17289 by leveraging the formal OpenRPC interface.

result.summary: This PR adds a functional test (tool_rpc_autocompletion.py) that generates the bitcoin-cli bash autocompletion file by querying getopenrpcinfo. The test verifies that the committed contrib/completions/bash/bitcoin-cli.bash matches the generated output and supports updating it via an --overwrite flag. It also adds autocompletion support for named RPC arguments.
result.problem: The bash completion file currently has to be updated by hand whenever RPC arguments or commands change, which is error-prone and frequently falls out of sync. CLI users also lacked completion for named arguments.
